summary: County of Riverside opposes eliminating the E‑Rate program and urges the FCC to preserve it.

claims.argument: The County argues that eliminating E‑Rate would shift essential broadband and technology costs onto local governments, jeopardizing connectivity in rural and economically disadvantaged communities.
claims.evidence_quote:
pposition to any proposal by the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) to 
eliminate or substantially reduce the Schools and Libraries Universal Service Support 
Program, commonly known as E-Rate.
